controls.definition: Magnitude delta-p/p-ref of the imposed lunar-model parameter perturbation used in the MINEOS linearity check.
controls.name: relative_parameter_perturbation

applicability.statement: This is the theoretical linear-response reference used to check MINEOS calculations for inner-core shear-wave velocity, outer-core compression-wave velocity, and inner-core/outer-core interface-radius perturbations, for modes n at most 200.
The MINEOS results are assessed with a 25 percent deviation band; most modes, rather than every mode, satisfy this linearity criterion.

readouts.definition: Linear-response expectation for the amplitude variation delta-A(delta-p) relative to the amplitude variation at the 0.2 percent base perturbation.
readouts.name: expected_amplitude_variation_ratio

source.citation: Han Yan, Gravitational-wave Tomography of the Moon: Constraining Lunar Structure with Calibrated Gravitational Waves, Physical Review Letters (2026), DOI:10.1103/3tcp-hqf9
